title: Bench 1775

services.name: Tasting Experiences
services.desc: Located on the renowned Naramata Bench, Bench 1775 Winery offers magnificent views, stunning vineyards, and some of the best wines BC has to offer. Join us for a wine tasting at our waterfront tasting room and enjoy breathtaking views of Lake Okanagan. We are pleased to welcome guests of all ages, as our family-friendly atmosphere also extends to kids. Secure your preferred date and time by booking your wine tasting experience today. We are a pet-friendly winery, so all your furbabies are more than welcome here! Until September 6Open daily, 12 PM - 5 PMPlease note: We will be closed on September 5. Our Bistro is now closed for the season. Guests are welcome to enjoy grab-and-go charcuterie

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Looking for the perfect winery wedding venue or private event space? Look no further than Bench 1775 Winery. Our beautiful location in Penticton, BC boasts breathtaking views of Okanagan Lake and its surrounding vineyards, multiple venue options for up to 95 guests as well as what wine critic Anthony Gidmondi called the Okanagan’s Best Patio. Bench 1775 is ideal for your Okanagan winery wedding, offering a private vineyard setting to tie the knot among the vines and several ways to wow your guests right on the property with a personalized tasting or meal in an exceptional setting.
